idea-plugin.name: npm Trusted Publish Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the credential in your release workflow that expires before your next release

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → npm Trusted Publish Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 15 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/npm-trusted-publish-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/npm-trusted-publish-lint

action.text: npm Trusted Publish Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run npm Trusted Publish Lint on the file in the editor
